messages:
Ivy Park: Hi team 1 starting as an AE next week. Quick checklist: CRM seat (Salesforce), Dialpad number + softphone, Gong access, edit on AE playbook, the regional target list for "Central", and demo org credentials. Who should I ping for each?
Connor Wells: Welcome Ivy! Send your work email and I'll do CRM + target list. Also tell me if you need view-only or edit on collateral.
Ivy Park: ivy.park@redwood.ai. Edit on playbook would be great so I can add call notes.
Maya Ortiz: Ill take Dialpad + Gong. Dialpad tip: enable voicemail->email and set caller ID to local Central area code. For softphone, install the desktop app and sign in with SSO.
Ivy Park: Thanks Maya. Any preferred voicemail script for first outreach?
Maya Ortiz: Short one: "Hi, this is Ivy from Redwood Inference. Quick question about your LLM infra plans 3 can we grab 15 minutes next week?" Upload in Dialpad Settings > Voicemail.
Provisioning Bot: Ticket PRV-2992 opened for CRM seat, Dialpad + number, Gong access, and playbook permissions. ETA ~12 hours.
Connor Wells: CRM invite sent and added you to saved view "Central - AE Targets". I also uploaded the CSV to Sales Drive > Central. Demo org assigned in 1Password under Sales/Demos.
Ivy Park: CRM invite came through but playbook still read-only.
Connor Wells: Fixing perms now  gave you edit on AE playbook and access to the pitch deck + battlecards. Also added you to #ae-buddies channel.
Maya Ortiz: Gong invite sent. Shared playlist: "AE-Ramp - Core Demos". I uploaded 4 exemplar calls; watch the objection-handling clips.
Ivy Park: Dialpad number looks like +1-312-555-0178 and softphone signed in. Test call worked. Demo creds in 1Password OK.
Provisioning Bot: PRV-2992 update: CRM, Dialpad, Gong provisioned; playbook/edit perms granted; ticket closed. :white_check_mark:
Ivy Park: Perfect  thanks everyone. I'll review the playbook and post any follow-ups here or in #ae-buddies.
